remarks: Bright and spacious one bedroom apartment in the heart of downtown Stamford! This charming home offers abundant natural light, beautiful hardwood floors, and a comfortable layout with generously sized living and bedroom spaces. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances while the full bath offers classic details with modern updates. Crisp white millwork and rich accent colors add character throughout. Ideally located just moments from downtown Stamford's restaurants, shops, entertainment, parks and transportation, this apartment offers the convenience of city living while still feeling warm and inviting. A great opportunity to enjoy everything downtown Stamford has to offer right outside your door.
